extractions.description: This paper introduces a competency assessment framework for Machine Reading Comprehension (MRC) models. It assesses model capabilities in an explainable, multi-dimensional manner to better manage training processes. By incorporating it into a curriculum learning pipeline with a Capability Boundary Breakthrough Curriculum (CBBC) strategy, the framework aims to improve training efficiency by maximizing data value to enhance model performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate significant improvements on MRC tasks.
